basic.title: Admin authentication and least privilege
evidence_needed: Identify native authentication versus Adobe IMS and retain provider/MFA policy evidence.
Verify administrator enrollment, bypass resistance, unique accounts and approved least-privilege roles.
Confirm authenticated Admin session expiry and protections at the actual Admin origin.
basic.applicability: All Admin deployments; native settings may not apply to IMS.

basic.title: Web runtime permissions and effective document root
evidence_needed: Confirm the effective web document root is pub, or document an equivalent reviewed boundary.
Demonstrate that the actual PHP/web identity cannot write production code, including ACLs and mounts.
Verify media execution denial and sensitive configuration locks/precedence.
basic.applicability: Local or hosted Magento deployments; deployment-owner write access is not runtime access.

basic.title: WAF, Admin access restrictions and SSH MFA
evidence_needed: Retain WAF policy and monitoring evidence for the chosen hosting architecture.
Review Admin network access controls and SSH MFA or equivalent controlled administrative access.
basic.applicability: Hosting/access model dependent; Fastly or Adobe Cloud is not mandatory.

basic.title: Scheduled security scanning and notification ownership
evidence_needed: Provide an Adobe Security Scan or equivalent schedule, recent results and remediation owner.
Verify notification routing and follow-up on findings.
basic.applicability: Public and operational deployments; scanner access must match scope.

basic.title: Backups and tested restore
evidence_needed: Retain backup schedule, retention/access controls and a recent successful restore exercise.

basic.title: Store, cache, static and scheduler runtime coverage
evidence_needed: Confirm all active store and Admin origins use valid TLS and secure policies.
Match active themes/locales to deployed artifacts or document headless delivery.
Verify actual cache behavior and external/cloud/container scheduler execution, job groups and old failed/missed jobs.
Review effective runtime mode, worker/store debug overrides and lock precedence.
basic.applicability: Production readiness; bounded CLI observations do not establish complete runtime coverage.
